text: Electrical rooms, battery rooms and switchgear shall be located outside classified areas; where a room is close to a zone, the room shall be pressurised (overpressure of at least 50 Pa and airlocks) with filtered air taken from a non-hazardous location and with a fire and gas detection interlock; battery rooms shall have a ventilation of the hydrogen released (EN 50272-2) with hydrogen detection (alarm at 10 % LEL, charger trip at 25 % LEL, HV-DBR-0001 section 8).
